name: Mamba2Bwd

x.description: 输入张量, shape (B, T, H, P); bfloat16/float16/float32

dt.description: 时间步 raw 值, shape (B, T, H); 与 x 同 dtype

A.description: 状态衰减系数 (恒负), shape (H,); float32

B.description: SSM B 矩阵, shape (B, T, G, N); 与 x 同 dtype

C.description: SSM C 矩阵, shape (B, T, G, N); 与 x 同 dtype

D.description: 跳连系数, shape (H,) 或 (H, P); float32

z.description: 门控张量, shape (B, T, H, P); shape[0]==0 表示无 z

initial_states.description: 初始状态, shape (B, H, P, N) float32; shape[0]==0 表示无

dout.description: 输出梯度, shape (B, T, H, P); 与 x 同 dtype

dfinal_states.description: 末状态梯度, shape (B, H, P, N) float32; shape[0]==0 表示无回传

chunk_size.description: kernel 分块大小, int 标量

dt_softplus.description: 是否对 dt 施加 softplus, int 0/1

dx.description: x 梯度, 同 x 形状与 dtype

ddt.description: dt 梯度, 同 dt 形状与 dtype

dB.description: B 梯度, shape (B, T, G, N), 与 B 同 dtype (GQA 组内各头求和)

dC.description: C 梯度, shape (B, T, G, N), 与 C 同 dtype

dD.description: D 梯度, 同 D 形状 float32; D 缺省时为空张量 [0]

dz.description: z 梯度, 同 z 形状与 dtype; z 缺省时为空张量 [0]

dinitial_states.description: 初始状态梯度, shape (B, H, P, N) float32; 无初始状态时为空张量 [0, H, P, N]

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def run(x, dt, A, B, C, D, z, dt_bias, initial_states,
        dout, dfinal_states,
        chunk_size, dt_softplus, dt_limit_lo, dt_limit_hi):
    device = x.device
    Bsz, T, H, P = x.shape
    G, N = B.shape[2], B.shape[3]
    R = H // G

    xf = x.float()
    Bh = B.float().repeat_interleave(R, dim=2)
    Ch = C.float().repeat_interleave(R, dim=2)
    has_z = z.shape[0] > 0
    has_init = initial_states.shape[0] > 0
    has_dD = D.numel() > 0
    Af = A.float()

    raw = dt.float() + dt_bias.float()
    sp = F.softplus(raw) if dt_softplus else raw
    dtr = sp.clamp(dt_limit_lo, dt_limit_hi)
    a = (dtr * Af).exp()

    Df = D.float() if has_dD else None
    Dv = (Df.view(1, H, 1) if Df.dim() == 1
          else Df.view(1, H, P)) if has_dD else None

    S = (initial_states.float().clone() if has_init
         else torch.zeros(Bsz, H, P, N, device=device))
    S_all = torch.empty(T, Bsz, H, P, N, device=device)
    y_all = torch.empty(Bsz, T, H, P, device=device)
    for t in range(T):
        S = (a[:, t].unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1) * S
             + (dtr[:, t].unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1)
                * xf[:, t].unsqueeze(-1)) * Bh[:, t].unsqueeze(-2))
        S_all[t] = S
        y_all[:, t] = (S * Ch[:, t].unsqueeze(-2)).sum(-1)
    if has_dD:
        y_all = y_all + xf * Dv.unsqueeze(0)

    if has_z:
        zf = z.float()
        sig = torch.sigmoid(zf)
        sil = zf * sig
        dsil = sig * (1.0 + zf * (1.0 - sig))
    else:
        sil = None
        dsil = None

    S0 = (initial_states.float() if has_init
          else torch.zeros(Bsz, H, P, N, device=device))

    dof = dout.float()
    dxf = torch.zeros_like(xf)
    dBh = torch.zeros_like(Bh)
    dCh = torch.zeros_like(Ch)
    ddtp = torch.zeros_like(dtr)
    dAf = torch.zeros_like(Af)
    dDf = torch.zeros_like(Df) if has_dD else None
    dzf = (torch.zeros(Bsz, T, H, P, device=device)
           if has_z else None)
    dS = (dfinal_states.float().clone() if dfinal_states.shape[0] > 0
          else torch.zeros(Bsz, H, P, N, device=device))

    for t in reversed(range(T)):
        dy = dof[:, t] * sil[:, t] if has_z else dof[:, t]
        if has_z:
            dzf[:, t] = dof[:, t] * y_all[:, t] * dsil[:, t]
        S_t = S_all[t]
        dCh[:, t] = (S_t * dy.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(-2)
        dS = dS + dy.unsqueeze(-1) * Ch[:, t].unsqueeze(-2)
        if has_dD:
            acc = dy * xf[:, t]
            dDf += acc.sum((0, 2)) if Df.dim() == 1 else acc.sum(0)
            dxf[:, t] = Dv * dy
        dxf[:, t] += dtr[:, t].unsqueeze(-1) * (dS * Bh[:, t].unsqueeze(-2)).sum(-1)
        dBh[:, t] = dtr[:, t].unsqueeze(-1) * (dS * xf[:, t].unsqueeze(-1)).sum(-2)
        ddtp[:, t] += (dS * (xf[:, t].unsqueeze(-1)
                             * Bh[:, t].unsqueeze(-2))).sum((-1, -2))
        S_prev = S_all[t - 1] if t > 0 else S0
        ddA = a[:, t] * (dS * S_prev).sum((-1, -2))
        dAf += (ddA * dtr[:, t]).sum(0)
        ddtp[:, t] += ddA * Af
        dS = a[:, t].unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1) * dS
    dinitial = dS

    unclamped = (sp >= dt_limit_lo) & (sp <= dt_limit_hi)
    draw = ddtp * unclamped
    if dt_softplus:
        draw = draw * torch.where(raw <= 20.0, torch.sigmoid(raw),
                                  torch.ones_like(raw))
    ddt_bias = draw.sum((0, 1))

    dB = dBh.view(Bsz, T, G, R, N).sum(3).to(B.dtype)
    dC = dCh.view(Bsz, T, G, R, N).sum(3).to(C.dtype)

    dz_out = dzf.to(z.dtype) if has_z else torch.empty(0, device=device)
    dinit_out = dinitial if has_init else torch.empty(0, H, P, N, device=device)
    return (dxf.to(x.dtype), draw.to(dt.dtype), dAf, dB, dC,
            dDf if has_dD else torch.empty(0, device=device),
            dz_out, ddt_bias, dinit_out)
description:
Mamba-2 SSD chunk-scan 反向标杆。对标 state-spaces/mamba @ main 的 _mamba_chunk_scan_combined_bwd (mamba_ssm/ops/triton/ssd_combined.py:397, 由 MambaChunkScanCombinedFn.backward :596 调用), 返回 (dx, ddt, dA, dB, dC, dD, dz, ddt_bias, dinitial_states)。前向数学定义见 Mamba2Fwd。
反向 (逐 token 精确伴随, dS 从 dfinal_states 初始化, 逆序传播; 记 a_t = exp(A_h * dt'_t), W_t = dt'_t * x_t ⊗ B_t):
    dy    = dout_t * silu(z_t)
    dz_t  = dout_t * y_t * silu'(z_t)     silu'(z)=σ(z)(1+z(1-σ(z)))
    dC_t  = S_t^T · dy ; dS += dy ⊗ C_t   (读出路径)
    dD   += dy ⊙ x_t ; dx_t = D ⊙ dy      (D 跳连路径)
    dx_t += dt'_t * (dS · B_t)            (写入路径)
    dB_t  = dt'_t * (dS^T · x_t)
    ddt'_t += sum_{p,n} dS * x_t ⊗ B_t
    ddA_t = a_t * sum(dS ⊙ S_{t-1})
    dA_h += ddA_t * dt'_t ; ddt'_t += ddA_t * A_h
    dS   <- a_t ⊙ dS
    dinitial_states = 递推结束时的 dS
dt 预处理链反传: d(raw) = ddt' * [lo <= sp <= hi] * (σ(raw) 若 raw<=20 否则 1), sp = softplus(raw), raw = dt + dt_bias; ddt = d(raw), ddt_bias[h] = sum_{b,t} d(raw)。
reference 在 run() 内先重算前向 (逐步状态 S_t、输出 y、a/dtr/raw/sp、silu(z) 及其导数), 再执行纯反向, solution 同样只接收叶子输入, 需自行重算前向中间量。
输入约束同 Mamba2Fwd: A ∈ uniform(-16, -1), dt_bias ∈ uniform(-5, -1)。
